comments.content: curModule?.NestedModules.Count can throw NullReferenceException because the ?. only guards curModule, not NestedModules. If NestedModules is null, accessing .Count and then new HashSet(curModule.NestedModules) will NRE. Use curModule?.NestedModules?.Count > 0 and guard construction. Also HashSet<PSModuleInfo> uses reference equality, so Contains(moduleInfo) may miss logically equal modules returned by Get-Module; compare by Name/Path or use a comparer to avoid false negatives.
